title: Deployment plan document set
description: What a deployment plan hands to `nightscout plan check`: one entry per role process.

name.description: The plan's own name for the process (a service or workload name).

roles.description: The role list given to `nightscout multitenant`.

environment.description: The process environment. Connection addresses may be placeholders; none is dialled.

files.description: JSON files by the absolute path the environment names them with.
